name: Neve 1073
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Replaces the draft from Rea-Sixty. EQ gains and Output report raw numbers, so they are measured (table: true); the rest are stepped and read from their labels.
The high band is a fixed 12 kHz shelf and the low band a shelf; the mid (360 Hz to 7.2 kHz) is the high mid. A band frequency of Off reads as off and only carries to another 1073.
Level (the output level after the EQ) is not mapped; Output is.
